comparison.objective: Candidate removes four insert tangs; record cuts a pizza into quarters.
comparison.physical_skill: Both use bimanual support and force application, but candidate stabilizes a mandrel for localized hammer impact and recovers fragments, while the record steadies a board and rolls a cutter along two crossing paths.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four modeled-notch fractures, four contained tangs, retained inserts, and no damage; record requires two through-center cuts yielding quarters, wheel return, and arm retreat. No specs add numeric cut thresholds.
comparison.reason: Continuous rolling cuts through bulk food and localized brittle separation at manufactured metal notches are meaningfully different tested mechanisms; the candidate also uniquely requires fragment recovery and coil retention.
